depthStudies.text: A minimum of 15 hours of in-class time is allocated in both Year 11 and Year 12.
At least one depth study must be included in both Year 11 and Year 12.
The two Working Scientifically outcomes of Questioning and Predicting, and Communicating must be addressed in both Year 11 and Year 12.
A minimum of two additional Working Scientifically skills outcomes, and further development of at least one Knowledge and Understanding outcome, are to be addressed in all depth studies.

practicalInvestigations.text: *15 hours must be allocated to depth studies within the 120 indicative course hours.

Scientific investigations include both practical investigations and secondary-sourced investigations. Practical investigations are an essential part of the Year 11 course and must occupy a minimum of 35 hours of course time, including time allocated to practical investigations in depth studies.

siteExtras.scope: Addition and condensation polymer synthesis is not a named Module 1 action. Use only a relevant structure/property illustration, not a new required lesson.
Half-life calculations exceed the listed Year 11 nuclear balancing/radiation action; optional extension.
Yield and purity are useful mole applications, not separately named mandatory actions; add only if they serve a chosen question.
Basic volumetric analysis can support concentration; Year 12 acid-base equilibrium theory remains out.

note: Coverage does not clear scientific accuracy, safe practical use, cultural permissions, motion, recording or release.
